_comment: ADVANCED bundle variable overrides. Copy the keys you need into .databricks/bundle/<target>/variable-overrides.json (DAB auto-loads that exact path; a repo-root file is NOT picked up). For a minimal starting point use variable-overrides.example.json instead. JSON has no comments, so the _comment/_* keys below are documentation only -- DAB ignores unknown top-level keys, but delete them if your tooling is strict. Every key here maps to a variable defined in variables.yml / resources/app_variables.yml.
_comment_node_type: Job-cluster node type. AWS i3.2xlarge (default), Azure Standard_D8s_v3, GCP n2-highmem-8.
_comment_model: LLM endpoint used by BOTH jobs and the app. Default databricks-claude-sonnet-4-6.
_comment_cluster_policy: CLUSTER POLICY: a plain string ID, wired into both classic job clusters (metadata_job_cluster + lakebase_job_cluster). Left EMPTY here so copying this file verbatim gives a safe policy-free deploy; to apply a policy set policy_id to your cluster policy ID (e.g. "001DD81A49229D7C", from Settings > Compute > Cluster policies). Requires Databricks CLI >= 1.10.0, which drops an empty policy_id before deploy (older CLIs send "" and the Jobs API rejects it). ADVANCED: for full cluster tuning you can instead override the WHOLE metadata_job_cluster complex variable -- copy its default block from variables.yml, keep node_type_id/spark_version, and add policy_id + apply_policy_default_values.
_comment_budget_policy: Serverless budget policy ID for cost attribution on serverless jobs. Plain string variable -- empty is accepted at job level. Left EMPTY here so verbatim copy is safe; set it to your budget policy UUID to attribute serverless cost.
_comment_run_as: Identity jobs run as. Default is the deploying user. Set an SP to own all jobs (the old spn_id). The SP needs USE CATALOG/USE SCHEMA/CREATE TABLE/SELECT/MODIFY on the target schema plus CAN_ATTACH_TO on clusters.
_comment_app: app_name = app display name + job-name prefix. app_name_suffix appends to both, so multiple instances can coexist in one workspace (the app is a singleton by name).
_comment_app_display_name: Display name shown in the app UI title bar. MUST be non-empty -- an empty value is stripped by the DAB SDK and rejected on deploy. Defaults to dbxmetagen.
_comment_obo: enable_obo flips the RUNTIME principal (user token vs app SP). user_api_scopes is declared on EVERY deploy by default (files.files, serving.serving-endpoints, sql.statement-execution, dashboards.genie) -- override only to customize, or set [] to opt out where the workspace lacks the user-token-passthrough feature. Re-consent in an incognito window after any OBO/scope change.
_comment_permissions: Who can open the app UI (CAN_USE). Replaces the old permission_groups / permission_users env vars. The deploying user already has CAN_MANAGE.
_comment_lakebase: Lakebase config for accelerated GraphRAG graph queries (used by sync_graph_lakebase_job). The app auto-detects Lakebase when the database resource is attached in the Apps UI.
